mapper.select: SELECT r.role_code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_code = ur.role_code WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.role_code

SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_code = ur.role_code JOIN sys_permission p ON p.permission_code = rp.permission_code WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.permission_code

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.username AS username, u.display_name AS displayName, u.department AS department, r.role_code AS roleCode, r.role_name AS roleName FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_code = ur.role_code ORDER BY u.user_id, r.role_code

SELECT r.role_code AS roleCode, r.role_name AS roleName, r.description AS roleDescription, p.permission_code AS permissionCode, p.permission_name AS permissionName FROM sys_role r LEFT JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_code = r.role_code LEFT JOIN sys_permission p ON p.permission_code = rp.permission_code ORDER BY r.role_code, p.permission_code
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ur.user_id) FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_code = ur.role_code WHERE r.role_code = 'ADMIN'
